_comment: All print geometry lives here. Change values, then run `npm run build`. Units: millimetres unless noted.

card._size_note: 56 x 87 mm is the size commonly reported for UNO cards by retailers and accessory makers. It is NOT an official Mattel/UNO specification (none was found). Confirm the finished size with the print department; any size works, the card layout is in mm and adapts. Reference sizes: bridge 57.2 x 88.9 mm (2.25 x 3.5 in), poker 63.5 x 88.9 mm (2.5 x 3.5 in).
card._corner_note: The PDF artwork is square-cornered with bleed; rounded corners are a finishing (die-cut) option at the printer. The radius is only used for the on-screen previews.

text_fit._comment: Starting font sizes in pt. Text that does not fit is shrunk automatically, never below min_pt; anything still overflowing is reported as a QC failure.

color._comment: The PDFs are rendered by Chrome/Edge, which always writes RGB (DeviceRGB, colour values defined as sRGB hex in design/tokens.css). These fields describe the colour request that goes into the print specification sheet; they do not convert the file. CMYK/PDF-X conversion must be done by the print department's prepress (or a prepress tool) with their profile.
color.delivered_color_space: RGB (sRGB values, DeviceRGB in the PDF)
color.cmyk_profile: to be confirmed by the print department (e.g. PSO Coated v3 / FOGRA51 or ISO Coated v2 / FOGRA39 for coated stock)

pdf._comment: Checks applied to every exported PDF by scripts/check-pdf.mjs.
pdf._allowed_extra_fonts_note: Card text must use the two project fonts (Atkinson Hyperlegible, Barlow Condensed). If a card needs characters they lack (e.g. Greek or CJK), Chrome substitutes a system font and the font check fails; list that font family here to accept it knowingly.
pdf._min_image_ppi_note: All current artwork is vector (no raster images). Any photo or bitmap added later must reach this effective resolution at its printed size.
pdf.author: International Fair — Airport Gates card game

home_print._duplex_flip_options: long-edge | short-edge — must match the setting chosen in the printer dialog
home_print._back_offset_comment: Use the alignment test page to measure your printer's duplex shift, then enter a correction here (positive x = move backs right, positive y = move backs down, as seen when looking at the back side).
home_print._packing_comment: gate-pure: every sheet holds cards of one gate only, so every back on a sheet is identical and a wrong flip setting can never pair a front with another gate's back.

print_shop._page_order_options: front-back-interleaved (page 1 = card 1 front, page 2 = card 1 back, …) | fronts-then-backs (pages 1–180 = fronts, 181–360 = backs in the same card order)
print_shop._note: Generic professional defaults (3 mm bleed, crop marks outside the bleed, TrimBox/BleedBox set). Confirm colour profile, file format and imposition with the chosen printer before ordering.

manual_cut_a3._comment: Low-cost A3 sheets for cutting by hand: card FRONTS only (no backs, one-sided), printed at exactly card.trim_width_mm × card.trim_height_mm with no bleed. Built by `npm run build:a3` (also part of `npm run build`).
manual_cut_a3._orientation_options: auto (whichever orientation fits more cards; on a tie, the one with wider margins) | portrait | landscape
manual_cut_a3._cut_gap_note: Blank strip between neighbouring cards (waste). Each card gets its own outline, so there are two cuts per strip.
manual_cut_a3._min_page_margin_note: No card closer than this to the paper edge (most printers cannot print the outer 3–5 mm). The page labels sit in this margin, outside every card.
manual_cut_a3._cut_line_note: Thin navy outline drawn entirely OUTSIDE each card: its inner edge is the exact cut line, so no mark falls inside the finished card.
manual_cut_a3._min_text_clearance_note: Checked in the layout and in the PDF: every text box, header labels included, must be at least this far inside the card edge. Question/answer text, category and footer are also checked against card.safe_margin_mm. The small header labels (GATE x, CARD · CARTE) sit about 2.3 mm inside the edge: that comes from the shared card design (src/cards.css) and is the same on every PDF.
manual_cut_a3._packing_options: continuous (cards in data order, every sheet filled: fewest sheets) | gate-pure (each sheet holds one gate only: more paper)
manual_cut_a3._ink_saver_note: true = white header with a thin rule instead of the solid navy/yellow bands, and white answer-card background (src/cards-ink-saver.css). false = the exact artwork of the other PDFs.

spec_sheet.contact_note: Questions about these files: contact the International Fair organising team.

browser._comment: Optional: path to Chrome/Edge/Chromium for PDF rendering. Leave empty to auto-detect, or set the CHROME_PATH environment variable.
